sm_top.sm: Four vessels were hit by explosions in the Strait of Hormuz.
The UAE condemned an Israeli strike on a Gaza hospital.
Iran's Revolutionary Guard claims it shot down a US drone over Qeshm Island.
Estonian military provided details regarding a Ukrainian drone strike on a Russian missile ship in the Gulf of Finland.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted two Houthi drones.
Ukraine struck the Samara Urals oil hub and the Lipetsk-2 airbase.
Russian strikes on Zaporizhzhia damaged a residential building and an educational institution, injuring 15 people.
Russian attacks across Ukraine killed nine people, injured 61, and caused a fire at a Kyiv hospital.
China sent 100 warships near Taiwan in a blockade rehearsal.
U.S. forces shot down two Iranian attack drones as Iran claimed a strike on a U.S. radar in Bahrain.
The U.S. Embassy condemns a Houthi attack on Riyadh Airport and restricts staff access to airports in Jeddah and Dammam.
Russia attacked Ukraine with 96 strike drones, of which air defenses intercepted 81.
Ukraine launched nearly 1,200 drones at Russia, with Russia claiming to have intercepted 1,198 of them.
Ukrainian forces struck oil refining units at the LUKOIL-Volgogradneftepererabotka refinery in Volgograd.
An airstrike on a displacement camp in Rakhine State, Myanmar, killed 12 people.
Russian Defence Ministry claimed a strike hit port infrastructure and a dry cargo ship in Chornomorsk port.
Houthis claim the Saudi-led coalition launched dozens of airstrikes and missile attacks across Yemen.
An oil tanker caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz after hitting a mine.
Anadolu reported that Israel has carried out 793 attacks on health services in Gaza since October 2023, resulting in 1,725 health worker deaths.
Yemeni government forces fortified Aden as Houthi fighters advanced and encircled the city.
At least 44 civilians were killed in ADF attacks in Ituri province between November 9 and 12, following earlier attacks in North Kivu.
Oil spills from the ongoing conflict threaten drinking water in the Gulf.
Gunmen killed at least 38 people in an ambush on a market convoy in western Niger.
Russian attacks across Ukraine killed at least 7 and injured 80 people, with Zaporizhzhia among the worst hit regions.
Russian attacks across nine regions of Ukraine killed at least six people and injured 88 others.
Ukrainian drone attacks reportedly disabled a Russian missile warship, leaving crew members dead and wounded.
A deadly drone strike killed dozens of displaced civilians in Kiramu District, West Oromia.
IS-linked fighters killed 44 civilians in DR Congo.
An attack near Téra in western Niger's Tillabéri region killed over 30 civilians, with local sources putting the death toll at 37.
Russia launched a large-scale drone attack on Ukraine while Kyiv struck targets inside Russia.
Iranian state media report a strike on the US Navy's 5th Fleet headquarters and release visual proof of a destroyed military asset.
Gunmen killed 37 civilians in Niger.
Ukraine's power grid faced fiercer Russian attacks heading into the winter.
An airstrike on the Byala IDP camp in Ponnagyun killed eight people and injured many others.
Pentagon approves permanent US base in Poland with 5,000 troops planned.
Africa CDC reported that IS-linked fighters killed 66 civilians in Ebola-hit eastern DR Congo.
Russian attacks left parts of 12 Ukrainian regions without power due to ongoing strikes.
Police identified 48 Ukrainians killed in a previous Russian airstrike on Komyshuvakha.
An attack attributed to an Islamic State-linked group in eastern DRC surpassed 60 deaths.
US military personnel responded to unauthorized drone activity at RAF Lakenheath.
